Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: native transparent raster modular avatar character sheet for Horizons, brand NEW design.

For all: strong navy eyebrows, small white eyes with black pupils, a distinct long geometric nose using only a separate uniform muted warm nose color, jaunty open smiling mouth, no cheeks/blush/shadows. Skin itself one uniform color including ears and neck.
ROW 2 (second quarter), six DETACHED HAIR CUTOUTS with transparent face openings; nothing else in these cells. Left to right: 1 bold navy asymmetrical swept quiff, 2 compact dark brown blocky curls, 3 shoulder-length angular auburn straight hair with asymmetric part, 4 dark brown twin sculptural puffs with short central hair cap, 5 golden blonde angular bob with side part, 6 navy-teal angular wavy bob. All hairstyles sized to the same adult head silhouette from row 1; bangs stay above the eyebrows, long side pieces beside the face opening. Hair is uniform single-color each, no individual strands or highlights.
ROW 3 (third quarter), six completely NEW separate accessory cutouts. Different graphic shapes, complete clean isolated objects. No lighting, volume/shading.
ROW 4 (bottom quarter), six small CLOSED-EYE BLINK PATCHES matching row 1 skin tones and identical eye spacing. Each patch is one horizontal flat skin-colored band with two simple dark closed smiling eyelid arcs. NO brows, NO nose, NO mouth, NO head silhouette. The skin band has straight horizontal top/bottom edges and rounded outer ends, width matching the eye span of row 1 heads, about 110 pixels wide and 28 pixels high. Place at cell center. Use exact same uniform skin colors as row 1.
Canvas truly transparent, preserve native alpha. No white backdrop, checkerboard art, text, labels, symbols, cell borders, cast shadows. Every cell independent, uncropped, no overlap with adjacent cells.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied complete modular 6-column sprite sheet. Preserve EVERY silhouette, face shape, placement, cell spacing, transparent opening, component and the 1536x1024 grid exactly. Change only paint treatment.

Same for each hair cutout: exactly ONE solid hair color, no dark inner hair planes. Same for every accessory material: flat solid navy frame, flat solid orange cap, flat teal headphone arch/pads, flat magenta bag, flat orange scarf, flat navy backpack and flat teal straps. Do not add dark edge shading, gradients, bevels, highlights, texture, light effects, simulated volume, glow, drop shadow or ground shadow. Mouths/eyes/brows and noses remain separate graphic facial features. Keep blink patches same uniform face color. This is geometric 2D graphic art with solid opaque shapes, no lighting whatsoever. Preserve true transparent alpha outside every silhouette, including lens openings and hair face openings. No labels or text.
